name: avila-core

tool_versions.accepted: the executable whose SHA-256 the recorded run pins

inputs.name: stage inputs
inputs.carried_by: files named in the hash-bound descriptor
inputs.format: faris-core-stage-output/v0.2 and the scenario, physics and assumptions files

outputs.name: stage outputs (transport record, normalised rates, history, energy ledger)
outputs.unit: canonical decimal strings in the unit of the quantity
outputs.label: calculated

units: Core envelopes carry canonical decimal strings, and the original Rust artifacts stay verbatim strings, so no value is rounded at the boundary.
cancellation: Core runs through the job runner; cancelling ends its process group and the evidence run is not stored.

failures.reported_as: NOT_FOUND in `faris adapters list`; evidence is NOT_EVALUATED

failures.mode: a step has no completed receipt or a failed verification
failures.reported_as: the evidence run is rejected (exit code 1 for rejected evidence)
failures.next_step: read the failing step in the evidence run report

failures.reported_as: compile error from Core, shown as a compilation attempt, not a verdict
